> **NOTE:** The current resource does not support cdc.

```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

// get user info
const info = tencentcloud.user.getInfo({});
const appId = info.then(info => info.appId);
// create cos
const example = new tencentcloud.cos.Bucket("example", {
    bucket: appId.then(appId => `private-bucket-${appId}`),
    acl: "private",
});
// create cos bucket inventory
const exampleBucketInventory = new tencentcloud.cos.BucketInventory("example", {
    name: "tf-example",
    bucket: example.id,
    isEnabled: "true",
    includedObjectVersions: "Current",
    optionalFields: {
        fields: [
            "Size",
            "ETag",
        ],
    },
    filter: {
        period: {
            startTime: "1687276800",
        },
    },
    schedule: {
        frequency: "Daily",
    },
    destination: {
        bucket: "qcs::cos:ap-guangzhou::private-bucket-1309118522",
        format: "CSV",
        prefix: "frontends",
    },
});
```

<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="go">

```go
package main

import (
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3/go/pulumi"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/cos"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/user"
)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		// get user info
		info, err := user.GetInfo(ctx, &user.GetInfoArgs{}, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		appId := info.AppId
		// create cos
		example, err := cos.NewBucket(ctx, "example", &cos.BucketArgs{
			Bucket: pulumi.Sprintf("private-bucket-%v", appId),
			Acl:    pulumi.String("private"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		// create cos bucket inventory
		_, err = cos.NewBucketInventory(ctx, "example", &cos.BucketInventoryArgs{
			Name:                   pulumi.String("tf-example"),
			Bucket:                 example.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			IsEnabled:              pulumi.String("true"),
			IncludedObjectVersions: pulumi.String("Current"),
			OptionalFields: &cos.BucketInventoryOptionalFieldsArgs{
				Fields: pulumi.StringArray{
					pulumi.String("Size"),
					pulumi.String("ETag"),
				},
			},
			Filter: &cos.BucketInventoryFilterArgs{
				Period: &cos.BucketInventoryFilterPeriodArgs{
					StartTime: pulumi.String("1687276800"),
				},
			},
			Schedule: &cos.BucketInventoryScheduleArgs{
				Frequency: pulumi.String("Daily"),
			},
			Destination: &cos.BucketInventoryDestinationArgs{
				Bucket: pulumi.String("qcs::cos:ap-guangzhou::private-bucket-1309118522"),
				Format: pulumi.String("CSV"),
				Prefix: pulumi.String("frontends"),
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}
```

package generated_program;

import com.pulumi.Context;
import com.pulumi.Pulumi;
import com.pulumi.core.Output;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.User.UserFunctions;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.User.inputs.GetInfoArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cos.Bucket;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cos.BucketArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cos.BucketInventory;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cos.BucketInventoryArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cos.inputs.BucketInventoryOptionalFieldsArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cos.inputs.BucketInventoryFilterArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cos.inputs.BucketInventoryFilterPeriodArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cos.inputs.BucketInventoryScheduleArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cos.inputs.BucketInventoryDestinationArgs;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Map;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

public class App {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Pulumi.run(App::stack);
    }

    public static void stack(Context ctx) {
        // get user info
        final var info = UserFunctions.getInfo(GetInfoArgs.builder()
            .build());

        final var appId = info.appId();

        // create cos
        var example = new Bucket("example", BucketArgs.builder()
            .bucket(String.format("private-bucket-%s", appId))
            .acl("private")
            .build());

        // create cos bucket inventory
        var exampleBucketInventory = new BucketInventory("exampleBucketInventory", BucketInventoryArgs.builder()
            .name("tf-example")
            .bucket(example.id())
            .isEnabled("true")
            .includedObjectVersions("Current")
            .optionalFields(BucketInventoryOptionalFieldsArgs.builder()
                .fields(                
                    "Size",
                    "ETag")
                .build())
            .filter(BucketInventoryFilterArgs.builder()
                .period(BucketInventoryFilterPeriodArgs.builder()
                    .startTime("1687276800")
                    .build())
                .build())
            .schedule(BucketInventoryScheduleArgs.builder()
                .frequency("Daily")
                .build())
            .destination(BucketInventoryDestinationArgs.builder()
                .bucket("qcs::cos:ap-guangzhou::private-bucket-1309118522")
                .format("CSV")
                .prefix("frontends")
                .build())
            .build());

    }
}

## Import



cos bucket inventory can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Cos/bucketInventory:BucketInventory example private-bucket-1309118522#tf-example
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
